verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an official MCP server explicitly designed for natural-language operation — debugging delivery errors, monitoring pipelines, writing/testing transformations, and reviewing audit logs 'all through natural language,' and it works with mainstream MCP clients like Claude, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot. It also offers a Slack-based AI agent (Rudder AI) for workspace management via conversational commands. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's natural-language reliability and breadth beyond vendor docs.
